roleLine: Director of Infrastructure at CloudLinux, reporting to the CEO

outcomes.caption: annual recurring revenue - built #CloudMTS (MTS Web Services) from employee #1 and an internal hobby project into a hyperscaler (#2 in regional IaaS by revenue, MTS 2020 annual report), creating Cloud Hub, Cloud Billing, Open Cloud Standard v1/v2 and 14 cloud services
